title: Ziyarat Taziyah on Ashura
intro: The ziyarat of condolences associated with the later part of Ashura after Asr.
description: Read Ziyarat Taziyah on Ashura with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text:
In the last hours on 'Ashura Day it is recommended to stand up and address and offer condolences to the Holy Prophet, Imam `Ali, Lady Fatimah al-Zahra', Imam al-Hasan, and the Holy Imams from the offspring of Imam al-Husayn—the chief of martyrs— (peace be upon them all) on the astounding misfortunes that befell the Ahlulbayt on the Day of 'Ashura with a passionate heart and teary eyes. Then, it is recommended to address them with the following form of Ziyarah:

×

Salutation of Condolence

Recited in last hours of 'Ashura Day

In the last hours on 'Ashura Day it is recommended to stand up and address and offer condolences to the Holy Prophet, Imam `Ali, Lady Fatimah al-Zahra', Imam al-Hasan, and the Holy Imams from the offspring of Imam al-Husayn—the chief of martyrs— (peace be upon them all) on the astounding misfortunes that befell the Ahlulbayt on the Day of 'Ashura with a passionate heart and teary eyes. Then, it is recommended to address them with the following form of Ziyarah:

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ آدَمَ صِفْوَةِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha adama sifwati allahi
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of Adam, the select of Allah!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ نُوحٍ نَبِيِّ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha nuhin nabiyyi allahi
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of Noah, the prophet of Allah!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ إِبْرَاهيمَ خَليلِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha ibrahima khalili allahi
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of Abraham, the intimate friend of Allah!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُوسَىٰ كَلِيمِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha musa kalimi allahi
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of Moses, who received direct communication from Allah!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عِيسَىٰ رُوحِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of Jesus, the Spirit of Allah!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ مُحَمَّدٍ حَبِيبِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha muhammadin habibi allahi
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of Muhammad, the most beloved by Allah!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ عَلِيٍّ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنينَ وَلِيِّ اللّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha `aliyyin amiri almu'minina waliyyi allahi
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of `Ali, the Commander of the Believers and the intimate servant of Allah!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ ٱلْحَسَنِ ٱلشَّهيدِ سِبْطِ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waritha alhasani alshshahidi sibti rasuli allahi
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O inheritor of al-Hasan, the martyr and grandson of Allah’s Messenger!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O son of Allah’s Messenger!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ ٱلْبَشِيرِ ٱلنَّذِيرِ
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O son of the bringer of glad tidings and the warner

blocks.arabic: وَٱبْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
blocks.english: and son of the chief of the prophets’ successors!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ فَاطِمَةَ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka yabna fatimata sayyidati nisa‘i al`alamina
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O son of Fatimah, the doyenne of the women of the world!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O Abu-`Abdullah!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يا خِيَرَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ خِيَرَتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khiyarata allahi wabna khiyaratihi
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O select of Allah and the son of His select ones!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يا ثَارَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ ثَارِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya thara allahi wabna tharihi
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O revenge of Allah and the son of His revenge!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْوِتْرُ ٱلْمَوْتُورُ
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O unique (in suffering tribulations) and the oppressed!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلإِمَامُ ٱلْهَادِي ٱلزَّكِيُّ
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O guide, pure leader!

blocks.arabic: وَعَلىٰ أَرْوَاحٍ حَلَّتْ بِفِنَائِكَ وَأَقَامَتْ فِي جِوَارِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa `ala arwahin hallat bifina'ika wa aqamat fi jiwarika
blocks.english: and on the souls of those who presented themselves in your camp, resided in your vicinity,

blocks.arabic: وَوَفَدَتْ مَعَ زُوَّارِكَ
blocks.english: and came with the visitors of you.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنِّي مَا بَقيتُ وَبَقِيَ ٱللَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka minni ma baqitu wa baqiya allaylu walnnaharu
blocks.english: (Incessant) peace be upon you, from me, as long as I am alive and as long as there are day and night.

blocks.arabic: فَلَقَدْ عَظُمَتْ بِكَ ٱلرَّزِيَّةُ
blocks.english: Verily, astounding has been the calamity for us

blocks.arabic: وَجَلَّ ٱلْمُصَابُ فِي ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa jalla almusabu fi almu'minina walmuslimina
blocks.english: and unbearable has been the adversity for the believers, Muslims,

blocks.arabic: وَفِي أَهْلِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ أَجْمَعِينَ
blocks.english: for all the inhabitants of the heavens,

blocks.arabic: وَفِي سُكَّانِ ٱلأَرَضِينَ
blocks.english: and for the inhabitants of the layers of the earth.

blocks.arabic: فَإِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
blocks.transliteration: fa'inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji`una
blocks.english: So, we are Allah’s and verily unto Him we return.

blocks.arabic: وَصَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ وَتَحِيَّاتُهُ عَلَيْكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa salawatu allahi wa barakatuhu wa tahiyyatuhu `alayka
blocks.english: And Allah’s peace, blessings, and benedictions be upon you,

blocks.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ آبَائِكَ ٱلطَّاهِرِينَ ٱلطَّيِّبِينَ ٱلْمُنْتَجَبِينَ
blocks.english: upon your forefathers; the pure, the pious, and the elite,

blocks.arabic: وَعَلىٰ ذَرَارِيهِمُ ٱلْهُدَاةِ ٱلْمَهْدِيِّينَ
blocks.english: and upon their offspring; the guides and well-guided.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلايَ وَعَلَيْهِمْ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you O my master, upon them,

blocks.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ رُوحِكَ وَعَلَىٰ أَرْوَاحِهِمْ
blocks.english: upon your soul, upon their souls,

blocks.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ تُرْبَتِكَ وَعَلَىٰ تُرْبَتِهِمْ
blocks.english: upon the soil in which you are buried, and upon the soil in which they are buried.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لَقِّهِمْ رَحْمَةً وَرِضْوَاناً
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) shed over them mercy, pleasure (of You),

blocks.arabic: وَرَوْحاً وَرَيْحَاناً
blocks.english: happiness, and bounty.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, my master Abu-`Abdullah;

blocks.arabic: يَا بْنَ خَاتَمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
blocks.english: O Son of the Seal of the Prophets,

blocks.arabic: وَيَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
blocks.english: son of the Chief of the Prophets’ successors,

blocks.arabic: وَيَا بْنَ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمينَ
blocks.english: and son of the doyenne of the women of the world.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا شَهِيدُ يَا بْنَ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O martyr, son of the martyr,

blocks.arabic: يَا أَخَا ٱلشَّهيدِ يَا أَبَا ٱلشُّهَدَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: ya akha alshshahidi ya aba alshshuhada'i
blocks.english: brother of the martyr, and father of the martyrs.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بَلِّغْهُ عَنِّي فِي هٰذِهِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) convey to him on behalf of me at this hour,

blocks.arabic: وَفِي هٰذَا ٱلْيَوْمِ
blocks.english: on this day,

blocks.arabic: وَفِي هٰذَا ٱلْوَقْتِ
blocks.english: at this moment,

blocks.arabic: وَفِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ
blocks.english: and at all time

blocks.arabic: تَحِيَّةً كَثيرَةً وَسَلاماً
blocks.english: abundant greetings and salutations.

blocks.arabic: سَلاَمُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: salamu allahi `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Peace, mercy, and blessings of Allah be upon you,

blocks.arabic: يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
blocks.english: O son of the master of the nations,

blocks.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ ٱلْمُسْتَشْهَدِينَ مَعَكَ سَلاَماً مُتَّصِلاً
blocks.english: and upon those whom were martyred with you by such incessant greetings

blocks.arabic: مَا ٱتَّصَلَ ٱللَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهارُ
blocks.english: that endure as long as there are day and night.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon al-Husayn, the son of `Ali, the martyr.

blocks.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon `Ali, the son of al-Husayn, the martyr.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلشَّهِيدِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `ala al`abbasi bni amiri almu'minina alshshahidi
blocks.english: Peace be upon al-`Abbas, the son of the Commander of the Believers, the martyr.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلشُّهَداءِ مِنْ وُلْدِ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `ala alshshuhada'i min wuldi amiri almu'minina
blocks.english: Peace be upon the martyrs from among the descendants of the Commander of the Believers.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلشُّهَداءِ مِنْ وُلْدِ ٱلْحَسَنِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon the martyrs from among the descendants of al-Hasan.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ ٱلشُّهَداءِ مِنْ وُلْدِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon the martyrs from among the descendants of al-Husayn.

blocks.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَىٰ ٱلشُّهَداءِ مِنْ وُلْدِ جَعْفَرٍ وَعَقِيلٍ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `ala alshshuhada'i min wuldi ja`farin wa `aqilin
blocks.english: Peace be upon the martyrs from among the descendants of Ja`far and `Aqil.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ مُسْتَشْهَدٍ مَعَهُمْ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `ala kulli mustash-hadin ma`ahum min almu'minina
blocks.english: Peace be upon all the believers whom were martyred with them.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

blocks.arabic: وَبَلِّغْهُمْ عَنِّي تَحِيَّةً كَثِيرَةً وَسَلاَماً
blocks.transliteration: wa ballighhum `anni tahiyyatan kathiratan wa salaman
blocks.english: and convey to them abundant greetings and salutations on behalf of me.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يا رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Messenger!

blocks.arabic: أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ٱلْعَزَاءَ فِي وَلَدِكَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.transliteration: ahsana allahu laka al`aza'a fi waladika alhusayni
blocks.english: May Allah confer upon you excellent consolation concerning the (tragedy) of al-Husayn, your son.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا فَاطِمَةُ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Fatimah!

blocks.arabic: أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَكِ ٱلْعَزَاءَ فِي وَلَدِكِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.transliteration: ahsana allahu laki al`aza'a fi waladiki alhusayni
blocks.english: May Allah confer upon you excellent consolation concerning the (tragedy) of al-Husayn, your son.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Believers!

blocks.arabic: أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ٱلْعَزَاءَ فِي وَلَدِكَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.transliteration: ahsana allahu laka al`aza'a fi waladika alhusayni
blocks.english: May Allah confer upon you excellent consolation concerning the (tragedy) of al-Husayn, your son.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْحَسَنُ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, Abu-Muhammad al-Hasan!

blocks.arabic: أَحْسَنَ ٱللَّهُ لَكَ ٱلْعَزَاءَ فِي أَخِيكَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ
blocks.transliteration: ahsana allahu laka al`aza'a fi akhika alhusayni
blocks.english: May Allah confer upon you excellent consolation concerning the (tragedy) of al-Husayn, your son.

blocks.arabic: يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: O my master, Abu-`Abdullah!

blocks.arabic: أَنَا َضَيْفُ ٱللَّهِ َوضَيْفُكَ
blocks.english: I am now Allah’s and your guest

blocks.arabic: وَجَارُ ٱللَّهِ وَجَارُكَ
blocks.english: and Allah’s and your neighbor!

blocks.arabic: وَلِكُلِّ ضَيْفٍ وَجَارٍ قِرَىً
blocks.transliteration: wa likulli dayfin wa jarin qiran
blocks.english: Each guest and neighbor must receive hospitality!

blocks.arabic: وَقِرَايَ فِي هٰذَا ٱلْوَقْتِ
blocks.english: My hospitality at this time

blocks.arabic: أَنْ تَسْأَلَ ٱللَّهَ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: an tas'ala allaha subhanahu wa ta`ala
blocks.english: is that you may beseech Almighty Allah

blocks.arabic: أَنْ يَرْزُقَنِي فَكَاكَ رَقَبَتِي مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
blocks.transliteration: an yarzuqani fakaka raqabati min alnnari
blocks.english: to release me from Hellfire.

blocks.arabic: إِنَّهُ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَاءِ قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ
blocks.english: Verily, He is Hearer of prayers, Nigh, and Responsive.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت تعزیہ روز عاشورا کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
